final: WITH per_order AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) AS avg_fill FROM orderexecutions WHERE fillcount IS NOT NULL AND fillcount <> 0 GROUP BY ordersmark), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS benchmark1 FROM per_order), first_kept AS (SELECT p.ordersmark, p.avg_fill, p.avg_fill - o.benchmark1 AS first_excess FROM per_order p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_fill > o.benchmark1), second_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS benchmark2 FROM first_kept), final_kept AS (SELECT f.avg_fill, f.first_excess, f.avg_fill - b.benchmark2 AS second_excess FROM first_kept f CROSS JOIN second_benchmark b WHERE f.avg_fill > b.benchmark2) SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS avg_final_fill_quantity, AVG(first_excess) AS avg_first_excess, AVG(second_excess) AS avg_second_excess FROM final_kept
